template.style: Painterly, full-bleed, textured and atmospheric literary art. One dominant light source; shared charcoal-indigo, smoke-blue, muted ochre, moon-ivory and umber palette; a single dominant silhouette that holds at 108x162.
template.artwork_spec: Text-free original artwork, exact 1024x1536 2:3 portrait. Reserve a quiet upper-third title zone and lower author zone. No embedded text, pseudo-text, logo, signature, watermark, border or physical-book mockup.
template.anti_repetition: Every cover gets one declared composition type and unique recipe. No composition type exceeds one third of the set. Reject period shorthand, generic AI illustration and embedded pseudo-text.
template.overlay: EB Garamond title in a subtle upper-third scrim; author uppercase/small-caps treatment in matching lower scrim; fixed margins and sizes from render_v2.py.

tinct-cover-v2.review_notes: Reviewed as a 10-title shelf at full size and at 108x162 on #141210. The four composition categories are balanced without duplicate recipes; all title and author text is the deterministic overlay, never generation output.
